studies.Population: men aged 67-96 years in the AGES-Reykjavik cohort
studies.Reference: Consumption of fish products across the lifespan and prostate cancer risk.

studies.exposure_measurement_supporting_text: using a validated food frequency questionnaire

sample_size.excerpt: Among the 2268 men, we ascertained 214 prevalent and 133 incident prostate cancer cases, of which 63 had advanced disease.
